claims.quote: Type locality is given as 'Baram River, Sarawak state, Borneo, East Malaysia', which corresponds to the Baram River drainage in the Malaysian state of Sarawak, Borneo.
Originally it comes from the river Baram on Borneo, which flows through the Malaysian part (Sarawak) of the big island.
